matches.collapse: file group toggles its match rows

body.cap: 16 flattened rows default with head/tail retention

copy.scope: full structured result, independent of cap/collapse

safeLinks: only http(s) URLs become external anchors; other URLs render plain text
interaction: unsafe URLs never become href anchors
aria: expand button exposes aria-expanded and localized label
vcpDeviation: SearchBlock is a frozen tool-detail primitive; this contract is source-only and must not alter VCP tool/chat rendering.
